newsitem.title: USA: Florida to sell $166.655 million GO bonds Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Florida to sell $166.655 million GO bonds Thursday.

text.p: Florida will sell $160.655 million of general obligation bonds by competitive bid at 11 a.m. EDT Thursday, the state Division of Bond Finance said.
The issue is State of Florida, Jacksonville Transportation Authority Senior Lien Refunding Bonds, Series 1997. It refunds part of the Series 1989 and 1992 bonds and will ahve maturities out to 2022.

When the state put the sale on 20-hour notice earlier this week, the issue size was estimated at $125.81 million but the final amount was raised Thursday to take advantage of market conditions. ((--Jane Sutton, 305-374-5013))
